question: An optical device Y has positive focal length. Y is:

options.text: either a concave lens or a concave mirror
either a convex lens or a convex mirror
either a convex lens or a concave mirror
either concave lens or a convex mirror

solution:
The correct answer is __Option - (2)__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lens: ****Convex Lens** (Converging Lens) has a **positive focal length**. It converges parallel rays of light to a real focal point on the opposite side of the lens.
 
• **Mirror: Convex Mirror **(Diverging Mirror) has a **positive focal length**. It diverges parallel rays of light, making them appear to come from a virtual focal point behind the mirror.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The Sign of focal length depends on the direction of focus.

 __Explanation - __

__
 
• Positive focal length gives us an idea about the position of the focus point i.e. positive focal length means the focus point and object are on the different sides and the object is in front of the mirror or lens whereas the focus point is behind the lens or mirror. In the positive focal length,
 
• Or, the focus point is on the opposite side of the mirror or lens.
 
• Similarly,
 
• A negative focal length means both the focus point and object are on the same side and in front of the lens or mirror. 
 
• As we know the numbers lying on the right side/up side are positive and the numbers lying on the left side/downside are negative on a number line.
 
• The same concept applies here also.

 [IMAGE: https://media.geeksforgeeks.org/wp-content/uploads/20220926121434/SignConventionsforSphericalMirrors.jpg] 

Formula to calculate focal length in the mirror - __
(1)/(F)=(1)/(v)+(1)/(u)
__Difference between lens and mirror - __

 
 

 Basis of comparison
 Mirror
 Lense
 
 

 Meaning
 Mirror implies a glass surface with a silver polish
 The lens is a surface of glass or plastic, bounded by one plane or one curved or both curved surfaces.
 
 

 Nature 
 Plane or curved
 Usually curved with one side or both sides.
 
 

 Working principle
 Law of Reflection 
 Law of Refraction
 
 

 Equation
 (1)/(F)=(1)/(U)+(1)/(V)
 (1)/(F)=(1)/(V)-(1)/(U)
